reason: Provides plugin-scoped OpenTelemetry observability for dsh by registering trace, metric, and log providers, exporting telemetry to an optional OTLP endpoint, and bridging session telemetry into logs.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh 插件提供统一的 OpenTelemetry 追踪、指标和日志观测能力，并可将遥测数据导出到配置的 OTLP 端点。
summaries.en: Provides unified OpenTelemetry tracing, metrics, and logging for dsh plugins with optional export to a configured OTLP endpoint.

capabilities: Registers OpenTelemetry trace, metric, and log providers
Exports telemetry over OTLP/HTTP to a configured endpoint
Bridges in-memory dsh session telemetry into OpenTelemetry logs
